module_metadata.purpose: Godot 4.7 DrawableTexture2D, AreaLight3D, .gdshader stencil_mode, High-level Multiplayer (@rpc), and @abstract State Machine architecture.

drawable_texture_2d_4_7_new.description: NEW in Godot 4.7: A GPU-backed dynamic Texture2D that can be initialized via `setup()` and drawn onto directly at runtime using `blit_rect()` or custom shaders—eliminating the need for a `SubViewport` for fog-of-war, minimaps, or splat painting.
drawable_texture_2d_4_7_new.example:
var fog_tex := DrawableTexture2D.new()
fog_tex.setup(512, 512, DrawableTexture2D.DRAWABLE_FORMAT_RGBA8_UNORM, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.92))
sprite.texture = fog_tex
# Stamp a reveal brush at player position:
fog_tex.blit_rect(brush_tex, Rect2i(0, 0, 64, 64), Vector2i(px - 32, py - 32))

area_light_3d_4_7_new.description: NEW in Godot 4.7: Real-time rectangular area light source producing physically plausible soft shadows and rectangular specular reflections.

shader_4_7_features.conic_gradients_4_7: GradientTexture2D.FILL_CONIC — Native conic gradient fill for radial cooldowns and meters.

multiplayer_rpc_4_7.invocation:
my_rpc_func.rpc(arg1, arg2)  # Broadcast to all peers
my_rpc_func.rpc_id(1, arg1)  # Send specifically to server (peer ID 1)
